column1: # Rune Factory: Guardians of Azuma (this app's keys for an experimental port; never used once upstream has its own android.tsv)
# Diagnostics for the low frame rate: the GPU is the limit (GPU 20-200 ms a frame at 1280x720, CPU replay 8-15 ms). A timestamp around every render pass makes the per-frame log line
# list the passes that cost the most GPU time (size, format, draws); frames over 20 ms list their costliest passes. Remove these rows once the slow pass is known and fixed.
# Measured on a Poco X6 (Adreno 710): DM_VK_ASYNC_PIPE=0 (every pipeline built at once instead of left out for a few frames) was a clear improvement in speed and in the flashing lights.
# DM_VK_NAN_MINMAX=0 changed nothing measurable, so it is not set.
